title: 第8章 技能：苦藤缠绕
slug: 重生末日最强生存系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

孙悦看着林夕那略显痴呆的表情有些害怕的退后了一步开口说道：”林夕，你怎么了？“

听到孙悦的声音林夕一愣随后说道：”没，没事，我们稍微等一下再上去把。”

林夕嘴上说着话，心里正在疯狂的呼叫系统

“系统你出来，怎么才不算强行复制。”

“系统你为什么不说话！”

可能是受不了林夕的十万个为什么

随机电子音响起

”宿主面板信息已更新，请及时查看。“

林夕听到这个声音，急忙向自己的面板看去

跳过了其他的直奔异能

赫然发现原本异能后面的介绍又多出了一行

“神之手（能复制他人异能化为己用，复制上限随着等级的变化而增加，强行复制时间为10分钟，提示：复制需要他人没有排斥心理。）”

随后林夕便一脸痴汉样的盯着孙悦说道：“孙老师，你能让我牵一下你的手吗？”

”啊？“听到林夕这句话再配上他那色迷迷的表情的孙悦惊讶的发出声音

林夕看到孙悦的表情顿时一愣，随即苦笑的解释道：”孙老师，你别误会，你现在应该知道自己可以掌控冰的能力了吧？“

孙悦点了点头示意林夕接着说

林夕接着说道：”随着病毒，丧尸变异体的爆发，我们人类也会有一部分人觉醒能力，而你就是那个觉醒者，我呢也是，只不过我的能力比较特殊，需要复制其他人的能力才可以使用，现在你明白了吗？“

孙悦被林夕说的一愣一愣的但是也大概听懂了一些，便听话的将手伸了出去。

林夕一喜立马牵住孙悦的手

”检测到冰属性异能，是否选择复制。“

“是。“

随着系统复制成功的提示之后

Page (1/3)

Seeing Lin Xi's slightly demented expression, Sun Yue took a step back in fear and said, "Lin Xi, what's wrong with you?"

Lin Xi was startled when she heard Sun Yue's voice and then said, "No, it's okay. Let's wait for a while before going up."

Lin Xi was talking while her mind was frantically calling the system.

"If you come out of the system, why is it not considered a forced copy?"

"System, why don't you speak?"

Maybe it’s because I can’t stand Lin Xi’s 100,000 whys

Random electronic sound plays

"The host panel information has been updated, please check it in time."

Lin Xi heard this voice and hurriedly looked at her panel.

Skip the other stuff and go straight to the ability

I was surprised to find that there was an extra line in the introduction behind the original ability.

"Hand of God (can copy other people's abilities for your own use. The upper limit of copying increases with the level. The forced copying time is 10 minutes. Tip: Copying requires others not to be repulsive.)"

Then Lin Xi stared at Sun Yue with a crazy look on her face and said, "Teacher Sun, can you let me hold your hand?"

"Huh?" Sun Yue said in surprise after hearing Lin Xi's words and his lustful expression.

Lin Xi was stunned when she saw Sun Yue's expression, and then explained with a wry smile: "Teacher Sun, don't get me wrong, you should know by now that you can control ice, right?"

Sun Yue nodded and signaled Lin Xi to continue.

Lin Xi continued: "With the outbreak of viruses and zombie mutants, some of us humans will awaken our abilities, and you are the awakened one, and so am I. It's just that my abilities are special and I need to copy other people's abilities before I can use them. Do you understand now?"

Sun Yue was stunned for a moment by Lin Xi's words, but he probably understood a little bit, so he obediently stretched out his hand.

Lin Xi immediately held Sun Yue's hand

"Ice attribute ability detected. Do you want to copy it?"

"Yes."
